description: Improve the CLI submit-verify loop by adding a work type column to you work list, server-backed list filters (--name, --work-type-name, --trace-id), and a new you work show command for single-item inspection after submit.

context.customerAsk: Implement tasks/prd-cli-work-inspection.md: work type column on you work list, list filters for name/work type/trace, and you work show for post-submit verification.
context.problem: After you submit, agents cannot quickly confirm work type and state: the default list table omits workTypeName, list filtering is limited to state fields, and there is no single-item show command—forcing blind pagination or manual JSON inspection.
context.solution: Add WORK TYPE to the human list table; extend list-work OpenAPI and server filtering for name, workTypeName, and traceId; wire matching CLI flags; implement you work show against GET /work/{id} (session-scoped when --session is set) with human and --json output and direct CLI/API tests.

acceptanceCriteria: you work list human output includes a WORK TYPE column sourced from each item workTypeName.
you work list supports --name, --work-type-name, and --trace-id with documented semantics and server-side filtering before pagination.
you work show <id> prints id, name, work type, state, trace, and relation summary; missing ids exit non-zero with a clear error; you --json work show emits one work-shaped JSON object.
List and show commands honor --session the same way as existing you work list.
CLI and API tests assert observable stdout, exit codes, and HTTP filter behavior without inventory-style registration checks.
Quality gate: Go typecheck, lint, and relevant tests pass for touched packages before merge.

userStories.title: Work type column on you work list
userStories.description: As an agent verifying a submit, I want work type visible in the default list table so I can confirm the correct work type without --json.
acceptanceCriteria: Human you work list output includes a WORK TYPE column; each row shows workTypeName when present.
WORK ID, NAME, STATE NAME, STATE TYPE, and RELATIONS columns remain populated and tab-aligned as today.
you --json work list still encodes ListWorkResponse with workTypeName on each result.
CLI test asserts the human header contains WORK TYPE and a mocked row shows the expected work type.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified on origin/main (merged PR #475); human table includes WORK TYPE from workTypeName; tests in pkg/cli/work/list_test.go.

userStories.title: Server-side list filters for name, work type, and trace
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need list-work query parameters and handler filtering so CLI filters stay correct across pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI list-work routes accept optional name (substring), workTypeName (exact), and traceId (exact match on traceId or currentChainingTraceId) query parameters.
List handler applies filters before pagination; API tests prove work-type, name substring, and trace-id filtering.
Empty filter values do not introduce new 400 responses beyond existing contract rules.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified on origin/main: OpenAPI WorkListName/WorkTypeName/TraceId params; pkg/api/handlers.go workMatchesListFilters before pagination; API tests TestListWork_FiltersByWorkTypeNameNameSubstringAndTraceId and TestListWork_FiltersByNameBeforePagination pass.

userStories.title: CLI flags for you work list filters
userStories.description: As an agent, I want you work list --name, --work-type-name, and --trace-id so I can find submitted work immediately after you submit.
acceptanceCriteria: you work list exposes --name, --work-type-name, and --trace-id mapped to list-work query parameters.
Command help documents substring vs exact match semantics and pagination after server filtering.
Verbose stderr filter summary includes active name, work-type-name, and trace-id filters.
CLI httptest covers --work-type-name and --name query forwarding and filtered human output.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified on ralph/cli-work-inspection-v3 at origin/main: flags in pkg/cli/root_work.go; query mapping and verbose filter summary in pkg/cli/work/list.go; tests TestList_SendsNameAndWorkTypeNameFilters, TestList_SendsTraceIdFilter, TestList_VerboseDiagnosticsIncludeActiveFilterKeys pass.

userStories.title: you work show for one work item
userStories.description: As an agent, I want you work show <work-id> so I can inspect one item after submit without listing and scanning pages.
acceptanceCriteria: you work show <id> is registered under you work with the same --session routing as you work list.
Command calls GET /work/{id} or session-scoped GET /factory-sessions/{session_id}/work/{id}.
Human stdout includes work id, name, work type, state name, state type, trace id, and relation summary consistent with you work list.
Unknown ids exit non-zero with a clear not-found message on stderr.
you --json work show <id> emits one JSON object with workId, name, workTypeName, state, traceId, and relations.
CLI tests cover success human output, success JSON shape, and not-found exit code.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified on ralph/cli-work-inspection-v3 at origin/main (merged PR #475): show.go uses sessionpath GET /work/{id}; human/JSON/not-found/session tests in pkg/cli/work/show_test.go; registration in root_work.go with --session; go test ./pkg/cli/work/... passes.
